description: Publishes an invalid-JSON message and a syntactically-valid-but-non-object JSON message (a bare array) to a real topic the real run_consumer() is subscribed to, against a live Kafka-compatible broker, and confirms both are dead-lettered rather than dropped or crashing the consumer.
environment: local disposable PostgreSQL; live remote Kafka-compatible broker (dead-letter routing correctness has no timing-race sensitivity, unlike the CAS experiments, so a remote broker introduces no methodological confound)

dlq_messages.reason: invalid JSON: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 33 (char 32)
message body is not a JSON object (got list)

outcome: PASS -- both malformed messages dead-lettered with recoverable original bytes, no Task created for either, consumer connection survived, confirmed by a valid message immediately after becoming a real Task.
